data.long_meaning: The Arabic name Nacer means 'one who is born, brought to life, or revived'. It is derived from the Arabic word 'naçara' which means 'to be born'. This name is often given to babies who were born after their parents had lost hope, or to those who were born after a difficult pregnancy or labor. It is a name that symbolizes new beginnings, hope, and the power of life.
